description: Test 3: Chunk mode - prefill a module only when its full logical prefix is ready
metric_note: avg_ttft and avg_ttft_after_last_tool currently measure full generate() wall time, not true first-token latency. avg_append_calls is the average number of append_fragment() invocations per sample, not a time metric. overlap-aware metrics replay static prefill, incremental append prefill, and generation on a single compute timeline using each fragment's measured wall time and release time, so earlier append work can be hidden under tool wait.
